title: session.attach
description: Attaches this connection to the session (plan 027 §3.4): a snapshot, or the client's own cursor when the log can serve it, then every event after it as event notifications, synchronized at the cutoff, and a reset when the subscription ends. A connection holds at most one live attachment (a second is bad_request, reason already_attached). when: "ready" (the default) waits for the session's start; a start that failed is not_accepting, reason start_failed.

when.description: ready (the default) answers once the session's start has run; now attaches at once and answers ready: false while it starts, then sends one ready notification.

cursor.description: A place in the session's stream: the log incarnation and the seq of the last event the client folded.

budget.description: The attachment's budget, each member absent for the host's default: the subscription's maxItems and maxBytes (1,024 records and 8 MiB; lower, or higher up to the host's own bound), and the snapshot's byte budget (4 MiB by default, capped at 8 MiB).

subscription.description: The server-assigned id (s-1, s-2, …) every notification of this attachment carries.

ready.description: The session's start has run; false only for when: now while it is starting.

after.description: Where the stream continues: the client's cursor when honoured, else the snapshot's cut.

snapshot.description: The snapshot, embedded raw; absent when the cursor was honoured.

reset.description: Why the cursor given was refused (the first refusal's reason); absent when it was honoured or none was given.

cursorReason.description: Why a cursor was not honoured.
